workAbroad.title: Your path to working abroad,
workAbroad.subcopy: Labourmarket.ai is a digital international labour-force agency. Build one worker profile, see what each country needs, and let employers reach you when you are ready. We never promise a job or a wage — we help you get ready and get matched.

steps.title: 1. Tell us your trade
steps.body: Add your profession, experience and availability. It takes a few minutes.

steps.title: 2. AI prepares a draft
steps.body: The assistant turns your words into a structured profile and CV draft — a suggestion you review and edit. It never invents experience and verifies nothing.

steps.title: 3. Check country readiness
steps.body: See what documents and steps are likely required for the country you want — sourced, and not legal advice.

steps.title: 4. Get matched
steps.body: When an employer's need fits your trade, availability, accommodation, transport and language, you are shortlisted. Mismatches are shown honestly.

steps.title: 5. Booking and start
steps.body: Agree a booking with a clear readiness check. Contract and payment steps stay manual for now.
